mentions.name: Next Move Theory
mentions.description: A methodology providing a step-by-step algorithm for every product decision. It lays out every tactical and strategic move available and helps choose the best option with the odds on your side. The foundations are open and free, with AI skills to run it on your product.
mentions.audience: Founders and product managers in the US
mentions.source_excerpt: Next Move Theory is a methodology with a step-by-step algorithm for every product decision. It lays out every tactical and strategic move open to you and helps you choose the best, with the odds on your side. The foundations are open and free. AI skills run it on your product.
